- review KV/prefix caching options and batching settings

- Thu Jul 1, 10:00–10:45
- Fri Jul 2, 14:00–14:45
- Tue Jul 6, 09:00–09:45

Hi Karthik — thanks for the slots and the doc. Quick update from our side: leadership just re-prioritized our H2 roadmap this morning. The analytics team is being expanded and our focus for the next two sprints is moving toward a data-platform migration.

That means the LLM/inference proof-of-concept is being pushed to the backlog for the time being. Two immediate asks:
1) Can we release the calendar hold for the demo? We don’t want to take your folks’ time while we re-evaluate scope.
2) Keep the requirements doc and any demo recording you produce — we’ll revisit once the platform migration settles.

Appreciate your flexibility — still interested, just timing shifted.

Alex Murray
Senior Product Manager | Stonehaven Corp.

Also note: Stonehaven could be a strong Dedicated customer later — keep the deal record open but move forecast to 'Possible'. Deal ID STH-4721.

Thanks — Karthik
